Markets.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields has filed a Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering to raise nearly Rs 9,500 crore. The proposed IPO involves parent company Coal India selling a 10 percent stake, or about 66.18 crore equity shares.

Markets.summary: The Nifty's technical setup has improved significantly following a sharp rebound near its 200-week moving average. However, the index is currently approaching key overhead resistance levels that the bulls must overcome.

Markets.title: Binance targets full reopening of withdrawals by next week
Markets.summary: Binance plans to fully reopen withdrawals for all networks and assets by the end of next week. The exchange has recovered 95% of the $6.3 billion stolen in an October hack and pledged to fully reimburse affected clients.

Markets.title: Base metals lose momentum amid strong dollar and demand concerns
Markets.summary: Base metals have lost momentum due to a strong US dollar and growing demand concerns. The Dollar Index climbed to the 103-104 range, driven by resilient economic data and expectations that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates restrictive.

Geo-Political.summary: The White House announced that Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping plan to hold a historic joint meeting in China next week. A spokeswoman stated that Trump will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons during these unprecedented talks.

Geo-Political.title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision
Geo-Political.summary: All passengers were safely rescued following a cruise ship collision on the Mississippi River in New Orleans. Thirty-two people were hospitalized with non-critical injuries, but no individuals are unaccounted for.

Geo-Political.title: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
Geo-Political.summary: SpaceX aborted its attempt to catch the Starship rocket's booster during a recent test flight. As a result of the canceled maneuver, the booster landed in the ocean instead.

Data & Insights.summary: India's trade deficit widened to a one-year high of $39.88 billion in October due to a record surge in imports. Although both exports and imports experienced strong growth, the absolute increase in imports outpaced exports.

Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding economists' expectations of 6%. This rate crosses the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit of 6%.

Data & Insights.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning a new Investment Protection Act and escrow accounts to reassure investors about policy continuity. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu is also introducing reforms to accelerate business and economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Moody’s raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast to 7%. The rating agency expects the country to sustain this growth rate through 2028, driven by strong domestic demand and economic resilience.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's ups India's FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong economic momentum, warns of risks
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's increased India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast from 6.5% to 7% due to strong momentum and resilience. At the same time, the agency warned that inflation, deficient monsoons, and El Niño risks could threaten this growth.

India.title: 'At Peace, Satisfied': Man Who Killed Wife, 6 In-Laws In Bengaluru
India.summary: A Bengaluru man who murdered his wife and six in-laws told police that the family had humiliated him and disrespected him. Following his arrest, the killer stated that he felt at peace and satisfied with his actions.

India.title: Analysis | Punjab Polls: SAD-BJP Alliance Dilemma Ahead of 2027
India.summary: The Shiromani Akali Dal and BJP are weighing whether to revive their former 1997-2020 alliance for the 2027 Punjab elections. While reuniting could help consolidate votes, it risks reviving political tensions over the repealed farm laws.

India.title: "Political Tool": Brother Of Man Arrested For Threatening Arvind Kejriwal
India.summary: The brother of a man recently arrested for allegedly threatening former Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal has dismissed the arrest as a political tool. He claimed his brother is innocent and being targeted by authorities for political reasons.
